title: Bathroom First Fix
activity: Bathroom services before boarding and tiling
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are WC frames, basins and shower valves at the right heights and positions per the setting-out drawing?
Hot and cold pressure tested (7 bar) before boxing in?
questions.source: Borough WP4 ITP – pipework pressure test

questions.q: Wastes falling at least 18 mm per metre (no back-falls), air tested, SVP connection made?
Are isolation valves accessible behind a panel or removable fitting?
Are electrical supplies (shaver, mirror, UFH, extract) in the right positions and zones?
SVP air test 100 mbar for 3 min passed?
Waste air test 38 mbar for 3 min passed at 1st fix?
Ask the fitter: How will the valves and drain cocks be accessed once it's closed up? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

notOk.t: Valves and drain cocks with no access hatch / labels
Lagging over valve sets (blocks access) or damaged
WC pan not level, tap sleeves loose
Mastic missing around basin, bath, tray
Waste holes not fire stopped before back panels
Fittings missing at handover: rain head, rails, shelves, seat

ask.q: What pressure did you test the hot and cold to?
ask.a: 7 bar, signed off before boxing in.

ask.q: What's the SVP and waste air test?
ask.a: SVP 100 mbar for 3 min; waste 38 mbar for 3 min – no drop.

ask.q: How do you know the pod/WC connection positions are right?
ask.a: Checked against the pod setting-out drawing (74 series).
